# knows that

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/knowsThat>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent knows that a proposition holds — justified, standpoint-true belief held from a vantage. THE KEYSTONE: [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) [rdfs:subPropertyOf](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf) [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md), so asserting [`knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) materialises believes (knowledge entails belief); the reverse never holds. [`knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) is NON-FACTIVE: it carries no truth commitment and no isTrue axiom — it is a vantage-indexed CLAIM that (belief and truth-per-frame and justification) holds, never a global verdict. The reasoner never promotes justified-true-belief to knowledge; that judgement, and any Gettier defeater, is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)). Range OPEN, like [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md). Justification grounds are modeled in this module via [`gmeow:justifiedBy`](gmeow-justifiedBy.md) and [`gmeow:defeatedBy`](gmeow-defeatedBy.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> `?`

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record justified, standpoint-true belief held from a vantage — the keystone knowledge-that attitude; asserting it materialises [`gmeow:believes`](gmeow-believes.md) (knowledge entails belief), so reach for it only when the holding is justified, not merely held.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading it as a factive 'knows X is true' verdict — it is NON-FACTIVE, a vantage-indexed claim with no isTrue axiom; promotion of justified-true-belief to knowledge and any Gettier defeater is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), never a reasoner entailment, and truth stays per-frame on [`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md) / [`gmeow:claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md).

### How to use

- Point the agent at the proposition or reified statement; carry truth-per-frame on [`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md) / [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) of the holding statement, model justification grounds via [`gmeow:justifiedBy`](gmeow-justifiedBy.md) and [`gmeow:defeatedBy`](gmeow-defeatedBy.md) declared in this module, and rely only on the safe entailment [`knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) ⊑ believes — never on a global truth bit.

### Scope notes

- No factive knows: unlike SUMO/CYC knows, asserting [`gmeow:knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) commits the proposition true in NO global model — truth is per-frame ([`gmeow:standpointModality`](gmeow-standpointModality.md) / [`gmeow:claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md), standpoint slice). The only entailment is the safe one: [`knowsThat`](gmeow-knowsThat.md) implies believes.
